findings.location: architecture.md S4 Records/Decisions and S4 Targets; ADR-275 decision 4 ('It runs only when no structure row exists'); architecture D6; ADR-274 rule 13 ('At each start, a connection without a mapping ... gets one')
findings.obligation: P5/K2: feature A adds only the 400 on an unmapped type; P1 nobody's behaviour changes. A Team or Portfolio created after the upgrade on a connection that has no mapping row must still save as today.
findings.remediation: State one rule that closes the hole: either a connection without a mapping row gets one on first Resolve/unit create (from its units' types, else create defaults) in the same transaction, or the 400 applies only to a connection that has a mapping; make ADR-275 4, ADR-274 13 and D6 agree, extend the qnt model with a connection added after the first upgrade, and give slice 04's oracle a scenario for it. Blocking: the slice 04 oracle and craft would be wrong. Counterexample: add a Jira connection after the upgrade, POST /teams with [User Story]; Resolve finds no mapping so every type is TypeNotMapped and the save is refused 400 where today it is accepted (DemoDataFactory writes WorkItemTypes at runtime, same hole).

findings.location: ADR-274 rule 10, fifth bullet ('less any default the other level already holds on that connection')
findings.obligation: P3: a connection with no units on a level gets today's create defaults for it; ADR-274 rule 2 allows a type on both levels (2026-11-27).
findings.remediation: Non-blocking. Delete the 'less any default the other level already holds' clause from ADR-274 rule 10 so the ADR matches P3, architecture line 484 and the qnt Plan. Counterexample: a Jira connection whose only Team reads Epic and which has no Portfolio gets an empty level 2 by the ADR, Epic by P3.
